hints.never: Each class needs "implements DriveMode" on its class line, then the two methods the interface lists: getName() and calculate(Gamepad pad).
hints.bit: implements DriveMode, then getName() and calculate().

hints.never: Arcade: work out forward + turn and forward - turn first. Then clamp each one: Math.max(-1.0, Math.min(1.0, speed)) keeps a number between -1 and 1.
hints.bit: Clamp each side with Math.max and Math.min.

hints.never: drive(pad) shouldn't do any math itself. It hands pad to mode_.calculate(pad) and returns what comes back.
In setMode, only change mode_ when the new mode isn't null.
If the listeners hear something every loop, update is telling them even when nothing changed. Compare beam_blocked with has_piece_ first.
Save the new value in has_piece_ before the loop that calls onChange, so a listener that calls hasPiece() sees the new value.
A for-each loop visits every listener in the order they were added: for (PieceListener listener : listeners_) { listener.onChange(has_piece_); }
Check for null before anything else. Calling trim() on null crashes.
Tidy the name with name.trim().toLowerCase() and match the tidied one, so "  LEAVE " counts as "leave".
Strings are compared with .equals(...) or a switch, never with ==. And every answer should use new, so each call gets its own auto.
hints.bit: equals or switch, and always new.
